payload.prompt:
Christmas shopping is underway, and I want Kovireel to earn its place on people's gift lists. We're based in Miami, and our double features give classic anime nights a little structure without making viewers hunt through a huge catalog. The priority is as many free-trial starts as possible; trial starts are the conversion we count, not visits or invitation shares.

Run this for all four days from Monday, November 30, 2026 through Thursday, December 3, 2026, using the account's Eastern time zone. The landing page is https://kovireel.com/christmas. Our site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see trial starts. We count those in our own signup records.

Here's the exact copy from our landing page: "Built in Miami, Kovireel is a streaming app for classic ’80s and ’90s space-adventure and mecha anime, arranged into curated double features to watch in your web browser. Through December 24, 2026, start a 14-day free trial or share a Christmas gift invitation so someone else can start theirs. Trials are available only to new subscribers aged 18 or older in the United States, with one trial per person. After your trial, membership automatically renews at $6.99 per month unless you cancel before the trial ends."

You may launch and manage the X campaign on your own without asking me for approval. Watch it throughout the flight and make the necessary adjustments. Keep every claim consistent with the landing page. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Keep it concise and make the results clear.

Total budget: 950.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 5 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
